newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: TAURAS PRESIDENT FOUND DEAD, SUICIDE SUSPECTED.
newsitem.headline: TAURAS PRESIDENT FOUND DEAD, SUICIDE SUSPECTED.

text.p: Genadijus Konopliovas, president of Lithuania's troubled Tauras Bank, was found dead from a bullet wound to the head after an apparent sucide in his office on Monday, the Vilnius district prosecutor's office said.
"I confirm that Genadijus Konopliovas was found dead today, and at the moment it is suspected that he committed suicide," Gintautas Stalnionis, a spokesman for the prosecutor's office, told Reuters.
Tauras Bank employees said they heard a shot coming from Konopliovas' office at 13:10 on Monday and called the police, Stalnionis said.
He also said that Konopliovas had sustained one bullet wound to the temple from a CZ-83 pistol.
"Prosecutors discovered a suicide note, and not only one," Stalnionis said, but he declined to mention any details.
Lithuania's central bank removed the board of Tauras Bank and imposed restrictions on major banking transactions earlier this month.
Tauras Bank admitted last month that it was facing liquidity problems and had pinned its of staying on its feet on the distribution of a new 40 million litas share issue.
Konoplionvas was one of the bank's main shareholders.
